summary: Regression backend+frontend for multi-bengkel multi-user flows completed. Core owner login, employee pending->approval, workshop creation/switch, inventory isolation, dashboard/menu/workshop/users UI checks passed. One critical register bug and multiple auth-hardening gaps remain.

critical.issue: Employee registration without email returns 500 Internal Server Error (DuplicateKeyError on users.email null). Expected validation error or successful optional-email handling.

Auth playbook requirement not met: app does not set access/refresh httpOnly auth cookies; response only carries bearer token in JSON (observed set-cookie is Cloudflare __cf_bm, not app session cookie).
allow_credentials=true is combined with allow_origins=['*']; this is insecure/invalid for credentialed browser flows and violates explicit-origin requirement.
No brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts; attempts 1..6 all returned 401 without lockout behavior.

minor.issue: seed_admin password-sync behavior is not present (requirement in auth playbook could not be validated because seed_admin flow is absent).

action_items: Fix register flow ordering: validate employee workshop_code before inserting user, and avoid storing email field when null (or adjust index strategy) to stop 500 errors.
Implement auth cookie flow (httpOnly access/refresh cookies) if required by playbook, or align playbook/spec with token-in-body approach.
Replace wildcard CORS origin with explicit allowed origin(s) when credentials are enabled.
Add login attempt tracking + lockout policy after 5 failed logins.
Add/implement seed_admin idempotent password update logic if this remains a requirement.
Align frontend env usage with policy (EXPO_BACKEND_URL key) to avoid config drift.
critical_code_review_comments: register_user inserts into users collection before employee workshop validation, creating partial-state risk and enabling null-email duplicate key crashes.
app_main.py uses default fallback values for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET instead of strict fail-fast env usage.
frontend/lib/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/expo extra, while policy states EXPO_BACKEND_URL should be the source-of-truth key.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (critical requested UI flows passed; one intermediate selector timeout resolved on rerun)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_* workshops/items and temporary employee accounts for pending/approval flow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-workshop UI flow is stable on mobile viewport: dashboard header context, logout in Menu>Sistem, workshop code/switcher, and users role/remove controls are rendered. Approval UI was validated by creating a pending employee and approving from workshop screen. One backend blocker remains in auth/register when email is omitted.
rca_of_issue: RCA-1: /api/auth/register 500 is caused by Mongo unique index on users.email receiving repeated null values because code inserts user with email=None before validating employee workshop data; DuplicateKeyError bubbles up. Repro: POST /api/auth/register with account_type=employee, valid/invalid workshop_code, and omitted email -> 500 after first null-email user exists. Mitigation: validate first, then insert; omit email key when empty (or use partial unique index). RCA-2: Auth hardening gaps observed by playbook checks (no app auth cookies, wildcard+credentials CORS, no brute-force lockout).
